name: Goggles tell you what is wrong

pages.text: Wear Create's $(item)Engineer's Goggles$() and look at a machine. Besides its tanks and progress, TFMG machines show $(item)red lines$() when something stops them:

$(li)a structure that is not complete,$(li)a missing fuel, flux or hot air,$(li)a full output or exhaust tank,$(li)a vat recipe that needs more heat or pressure.$(br2)When a machine sits idle, look at it with goggles first. The last chapter, $(item)Troubleshooting$(), lists every message and how to fix it.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
